# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_VWAP_RECLAIM_AFTER_LUNCH

**Filed:** 2026-09-05
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After the lunch lull (12:00‑13:30 EST), if SPY returns to VWAP from more than 1% below with a bullish engulfing candle, a short‑term bounce often follows. This captures intraday mean‑reversion post‑lunch when liquidity returns and VWAP acts as a dynamic support.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If time between 12:00 and 13:30 EST AND price crosses VWAP from below AND prior 30‑minute average price < VWAP - 1*ATR_VWAP AND current bar is a bullish engulfing (close > prior open AND open < prior close), then enter long at the close of the engulfing bar. Exit shape: Stop at the low of the engulfing bar (or recent swing low), TP1 at 1.5R, runner trails 15% off highest high since entry. Regime hint: Effective when VIX is between 12 and 20 (moderate volatility) and the morning session showed a clear directional bias (|morning return| > 0.3%); avoid during high‑impact news windows.
